confirmer: TIERED with HOROSCOPE-HAZARD CONTROL per Confirmation Standard. THE HAZARD, NAMED: the three branches (a domestic attack, b broad dissent, c attempted coup) cover so much of the event space that nearly any major crisis could be retro-fitted as the trigger - the registered failure mode of horoscope predictions. Controls: (1) the emergency declaration must be FEDERAL and EXPLICIT - a declared national emergency under explicit invocation of emergency scaffolding (EO 14420 / NSSTS / bulk-power expansion, or new declaration), not rhetoric, litigation posture, or state-level action; (2) the declaration must be functionally tied to completing authoritarian transition - used to override elections, dissolve constraint, or justify durable exception, not merely crisis management. TIER 1 (mechanism tell - footing live): IC/enforcement surge activity, pre-seeded roundup posture, or amplifier-ecosystem war-on-law-enforcement framing activation (the Minneapolis/Carlton signal). Confirms footing, not the declaration. TIER 2 (headline): federal emergency declared under the stated functional test, per branch (a) attack-on-soil trigger, (b) dissent-provocation trigger, (c) coup-pretext trigger. BRANCH-TIMING DIAGNOSTIC: October trigger implies branch A (fear of loss); post-November trigger implies court-rig branch (B/C) - timing itself is recorded as evidence, not confirmation.
confirmer_base_rate: Headline (Tier 2): low (~10-15% naive for an explicit federal emergency declaration within the window; deliberately low, and the two controls (federal-explicit + transition-functional) are what keep retro-fitted crises from counting). Tier 1 tells: individually moderate (~40-60%); footing-evidence only. Retro-fitted events that fail either control are logged as non-confirming, not near-misses.
confirmation_window: Through Jan 20, 2027 (regime retentions window; mirrors the power-retention card)
